name: Tsuruya
source:
Age: 17-18
Occupation: Brigade Honorary Consultant

Tsuruya was born on December 6 and is [url=/c71230]Asahina Mikuru[/url]'s best friend. She tends to be hyperactive and has a very loud voice. She has long green hair and a prominent tooth. She is friendly and laughs a lot.

At first, Tsuruya only seems like an excitable tomboy who loves to dive her head into fun things, like [url=/c71228]Suzumiya Haruhi[/url]; however, [url=/c71227]Kyon[/url] notices a distinct difference in that while [url=/c71228]Suzumiya Haruhi[/url] always pries into mysterious things and their qualities, She only accepts that they are mysterious and simply has fun knowing that fact.

While being [url=/c71230]Asahina Mikuru[/url]'s best friend, their opposing personalities tend to clash. Tsuruya is a loud tomboy who isn't afraid to take risks, getting dirty or playing sports. [url=/c71230]Asahina Mikuru[/url], on the other hand, is a shy girly girl who dislikes risky activity, being bad at sports and squirming when a ball comes close to her.

[Edited From [url=http://haruhi.wikia.com/wiki/Tsuruya]Suzumiya Haruhi Wiki[/url]]
